emulator: MAME 0.289, gameboy with no link device; tools/oracle/barcode_boy.lua answers the serial port the way a Barcode Boy does
screen: each code is scanned at the party screen's 'insert a card' prompt from one saved state, once with the flag at $C67F at 0 as a new game has it and once at 1 as the game sets it once the adventure begins; party and adventure are the 8-byte character record at $C9C3 when the decoder returns, which the game marks by writing $C679
